debate.translationZh: 关于哪家是美国第一家超市尚存争议，但多年来，人们普遍认为1930年在纽约成立的金·库伦超市是首创。
debate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

debate.sentenceEn: Along-standing debate is going on over the impact of school absences on students' academic performance.
debate.translationZh: 关于缺课对学生学业表现的影响，长期以来一直存在争论。

debate.sentenceEn: It has been under constant debate .
debate.translationZh: 关于哪家才是美国第一家超市的问题一直存在争议。

detail.sentenceEn: But can you give me your details anyway?

detail.translationZh: 研究人员称，交际抽象化反映了人们倾向于使用"关注更广阔图景和行动最终目的的抽象语言，而非关注细节和实现行动手段的具体语言"。
detail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

detail.sentenceEn: Super realistic masks are made from flexible materials such as silicone and are designed to imitate real human face—down to every last detail .
detail.translationZh: 超写实面具由硅胶等柔性材料制成，旨在模仿真人面部——精确到每一个细节。
detail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

detail.sentenceEn: There is the planning of the ceremony itself, the merging(合并) of two households and all of the details involved in that.
detail.translationZh: 这包括婚礼本身的策划、两个家庭的合并，以及所有相关的细节。

detail.sentenceEn: The new system means letters to patients now have more detail .
detail.translationZh: 新系统意味着现在给患者的信件包含了更多细节。

deliver.sentenceEn: In 2016 she moved to London and began by setting up a business delivering luxury hand-made food across the city.
deliver.translationZh: 2016年，她移居伦敦，最初创办了一家企业，在全市范围内配送奢华手工食品。
deliver.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

deliver.sentenceEn: So I started delivering products by bicycle.
deliver.translationZh: 于是我开始骑自行车送货。

deliver.sentenceEn: Of course, you're not actually practicing the action that would deliver your desired outcome (speaking the foreign language).
deliver.translationZh: 当然，你实际上并没有在练习能够带来期望结果的行动（说外语）。

deliver.sentenceEn: Siri has often been praised for its ability to interpret our casual language and deliver very specific and accurate results, sometimes even providing additional information.
deliver.translationZh: Siri因其能够理解我们的日常随意用语并提供非常具体准确的结果而广受赞誉，有时甚至还能提供额外信息。

deliver.sentenceEn: They worry assistants will one day be used to deliver advertising directly to us.
deliver.translationZh: 他们担心有朝一日语音助手会被用来直接向我们推送广告。

deliver.sentenceEn: It rents bicycles to deliver food.
deliver.translationZh: 它出租自行车用于送餐。

despite.sentenceEn: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteered, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
despite.translationZh: 一项调查显示，尽管有报道称许多美国人认为志愿服务很有价值，但只有26%的美国人参与了志愿服务。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

despite.sentenceEn: Another study involved people who could smell, despite missing the region in the brain that processes information about smells.
despite.translationZh: 另一项研究涉及一些虽然缺失了大脑中处理嗅觉信息的区域，但仍能闻到气味的人。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

despite.sentenceEn: The findings showed that, despite missing half of this critical organ, participants could function well.
despite.translationZh: 研究结果显示，尽管缺失了这个关键器官的一半，参与者仍能正常生活。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

despite.sentenceEn: Driving around town in a car is so normal to them that cycling seems weird and unusual — despite its boost from Covid, when bike sales exploded by 75 percent.
despite.translationZh: 在城里开车对他们来说已是家常便饭，以至于骑自行车反而显得有些异类——尽管新冠疫情期间自行车销量暴增了 75%，极大地推动了骑行运动的发展。

despite.sentenceEn: Despite increased business activity on Skillman Ave, many store owners insisted the bike lanes were destroying their area.
despite.translationZh: 尽管斯基尔曼大道上的商业活动有所增加，但许多店主仍坚持认为自行车道正在破坏他们所在的区域。

despite.sentenceEn: Take no action despite repeated warnings.
despite.translationZh: 屡经警告仍不采取行动。

display.sentenceEn: Is it a good idea to display luxury brands and other signals of status?
display.translationZh: 展示奢侈品牌和其他身份象征是个好主意吗？
display.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

display.sentenceEn: On a regular day at a local food market, people would find a display table with 24 different kinds of jams.
display.translationZh: 在当地食品市场平常的一天，人们会看到一个陈列着24种不同果酱的展台。
display.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

display.sentenceEn: In the study, the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display .
display.translationZh: 研究表明，展示的果酱种类越多，顾客满意度反而低于种类较少的展示。
display.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

display.sentenceEn: Guess which display table led to more sales?
display.translationZh: 猜猜哪个展示台带来了更多销售额？
display.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

display.sentenceEn: The study found that while the bigger display table created more interest, people were almost 10 times less likely to purchase a jar of jam than in the case of the smaller display .
display.translationZh: 研究发现，虽然更大的展示台能吸引更多兴趣，但人们购买果酱的可能性却比小展示台的情况低了近十倍。
display.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

display.sentenceEn: A display of a variety of products increases consumers' interest.
display.translationZh: 展示多种产品能提高消费者的兴趣。

district.sentenceEn: The city analyzed the data for businesses along those routes and found that by the third year, sales grew faster on five of the streets than in the district overall, on average — up to five times faster, in fact.
district.translationZh: 该市分析了这些路线沿线企业的数据，发现到第三年时，其中五条街道的销售额平均增长速度超过了该地区的整体水平，事实上，最高快了五倍。

district.sentenceEn: A pilot programme in a school district in Anderson County, South Carolina, has supplied students with electronic tablets loaded with assignments to complete in the event of a school closure.
district.translationZh: 南卡罗来纳州安德森县学区开展了一项试点计划，为学生提供预装了学习任务的电子平板电脑，以备学校关闭时使用。

district.sentenceEn: Tom Wilson, the superintendent(主管) of Anderson County school district , said the change away from snow days makes practical and financial sense.
district.translationZh: 安德森县学区主管汤姆·威尔逊表示，取消雪天放假这一变化具有实际意义和经济效益。

district.sentenceEn: But some parents object to the new policy if the vigorous debate on the Facebook page of Anderson County school district is anything to go by.
district.translationZh: 但从安德森县学区脸书页面上的激烈讨论来看，一些家长对这项新政策表示反对。

district.sentenceEn: The district will have a total enrollment of 3,742 students.
district.translationZh: 该学区的学生总入学人数将达到3,742人。
district.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

district.sentenceEn: They rendered the school unique in the district .
district.translationZh: 他们使这所学校在全区独树一帜。

diversity.sentenceEn: For their study—outlined in a paper in the journal Conservation Biology—the team looked at genetic diversity and spread among a Chinese panda population.
diversity.translationZh: 在《保护生物学》期刊发表的一篇论文中，研究团队概述了他们的研究，该研究关注中国大熊猫种群的遗传多样性及分布情况。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

diversity.sentenceEn: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity .
diversity.translationZh: 研究得出结论，若大熊猫觉得栖息地过于舒适，它们便不会离开去寻找新的配偶，从而导致关键遗传多样性的缺乏。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

diversity.sentenceEn: In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information on diversity ; in the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing: information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce compared to others in the same sector and location.
diversity.translationZh: 在基准条件下，参与者看到的是正常格式的电子邮件，没有任何多样性信息；在多样性条件下，参与者会看到每个职位的多样性评分：该评分展示了公司员工在种族、性别、教育背景和语言技能方面与同行业同地区其他公司的对比情况。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

diversity.sentenceEn: Participants in the diversity condition tended to click on job listings from companies with slightly higher diversity scores than those in the baseline condition: that is, participants seemed to be paying attention to information about diversity , and using this when deciding whether to click on the listing.
diversity.translationZh: 多样性条件组的参与者倾向于点击那些多样性评分略高于基准条件组公司的职位列表：也就是说，参与者似乎在关注有关多样性的信息，并在决定是否点击列表时使用了这些信息。
diversity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

diversity.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the current statistics about diversity in large corporations?
diversity.translationZh: 从当前的统计数据中，我们能了解到大型企业在多样性方面的哪些情况？

diversity.sentenceEn: It is very important to preserve their genetic diversity .
diversity.translationZh: 保护它们的遗传多样性非常重要。

depression.sentenceEn: Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression or anxiety.
depression.translationZh: 总体而言，这项新研究发现参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间没有显著关联。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

depression.sentenceEn: The study looks at symptoms of anxiety and depression among more than 70,000 older adults in Europe.
depression.translationZh: 这项研究调查了欧洲7万多名老年人的焦虑和抑郁症状。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

depression.sentenceEn: Thirdly, according to the American Psychological Association, regular physical activity (and especially outdoor activity) reduces children's stress and depression , and improves their ability to focus and learn.
depression.translationZh: 第三，根据美国心理学会的研究，规律的体育活动（尤其是户外活动）能够减轻儿童的压力与抑郁情绪，并提高他们的专注力与学习能力。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

depression.sentenceEn: Not only can walking make you less depressed, but according to a new study, depression sufferers who took a daily walk showed just as much improvement in their symptoms as people taking medicine.
depression.translationZh: 散步不仅能减轻抑郁情绪，一项新研究还显示，每天散步的抑郁症患者在症状改善方面与服药者效果相当。
depression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

depression.sentenceEn: What did the new study find about the relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression ?
depression.translationZh: 这项新研究关于参与者的出生月份与抑郁症状之间的关系有何发现？

depression.sentenceEn: It is linked with older adults' symptoms of depression .
depression.translationZh: 它与老年人的抑郁症状有关。

delay.sentenceEn: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
delay.translationZh: 经济学家表示，除了人们身体更健康、寿命更长之外，由于实际工资增长多年停滞，以及私营部门从传统养老金制度转型等经济因素的共同作用，也是导致人们推迟退休的部分原因。
delay.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

delay.sentenceEn: Severe weather that causes cancellation or delay is more likely in regions that are less able to handle the situation.
delay.translationZh: 导致航班取消或延误的恶劣天气，更可能发生在应对能力较弱的地区。

delay.sentenceEn: We often hide behind information and use learning as an excuse to delay the more difficult and more important choice of actually doing something.
delay.translationZh: 我们常常躲在信息背后，把学习当作借口，来推迟更困难也更重要的选择——真正去行动。

delay.sentenceEn: Previously, the doctors made voice recordings that were then transcribed by secretaries—a process that was costly and likely to cause delays .
delay.translationZh: 以前，医生们会先录制语音，再由秘书进行转录——这一过程既耗费成本，又容易造成延误。

delay.sentenceEn: What is one of the reasons for people to delay retirement?
delay.translationZh: 人们推迟退休的原因之一是什么？

delay.sentenceEn: The higher their educational level, the more likely they are to delay retirement.
delay.translationZh: 受教育程度越高，他们延迟退休的可能性就越大。

differ.sentenceEn: Because how the body responds to a drug can differ depending on the time it is taken, it logically follows that taking medicines at specific times could help increase their effectiveness and reduce unwanted side effects.
differ.translationZh: 由于身体对药物的反应会因用药时间的不同而有所差异，因此，在特定时间服药逻辑上将有助于提高药效并减少副作用。
differ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

differ.sentenceEn: This differed from the findings of a study from Harvard University in the US, which concluded that missing a few occasional days because of the weather did not damage learning.
differ.translationZh: 这与美国哈佛大学的一项研究结果不同，该研究得出的结论是，因天气原因偶尔缺课几天并不会影响学习。

differ.sentenceEn: In truth, natural flavors do not differ much, at least chemically speaking, from their flavor-boosting counterparts: artificial flavors.
differ.translationZh: 事实上，至少从化学角度而言，天然香料与其增味同类产品——人工香料——并没有太大区别。
differ.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

differ.sentenceEn: However, deviance can also describe a behavior that simply differs from the norm.
differ.translationZh: 然而，偏差行为也可以指仅仅是与常规不同的行为。

differ.sentenceEn: In what way does Sophie André's business differ from many food waste projects?
differ.translationZh: 索菲·安德烈的业务与许多食物浪费项目有何不同之处？

differ.sentenceEn: They differ in their reasons for continuing to work.
differ.translationZh: 他们继续工作的原因各不相同。

driving.sentenceEn: Research in human-vehicle interaction has shown even systems designed to automate driving are far from being error-proof.
driving.translationZh: 人机交互领域的研究表明，即便是为自动驾驶设计的系统也远非万无一失。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

driving.sentenceEn: "Warning fatigue" and distracted driving are also causes for concern.
driving.translationZh: "警告疲劳"和分心驾驶也令人担忧。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

driving.sentenceEn: No wonder using mobile phones while driving causes more crashes a year than drink driving , says the U.S. National Safety Council.
driving.translationZh: 美国国家安全委员会表示，难怪开车时使用手机每年造成的车祸比酒后驾车还多。

driving.sentenceEn: She stated that the driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving .
driving.translationZh: 她表示，卡车司机因涉嫌危险驾驶已被逮捕。
driving.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

driving.sentenceEn: How do parents keep track of their teen's driving habits?
driving.translationZh: 父母如何追踪他们青少年的驾驶习惯？

driving.sentenceEn: It likely won't ensure that the automatic driving system functions properly.
driving.translationZh: 这很可能无法确保自动驾驶系统正常运行。

decrease.sentenceEn: Regular exercise can significantly improve self-regulation and decrease disciplinary consequences for negative behavior.
decrease.translationZh: 经常锻炼能显著提高自我调节能力，并减少因不良行为导致的纪律处分。
decrease.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

decrease.sentenceEn: How those decreases will be felt will depend on the degree of warming and the crop in question, but in general, "anything over about 30℃ is very bad for crops," says Wolfram Schlenker, an associate professor of international and public affairs at Columbia University.
decrease.translationZh: 这些减产带来的影响将取决于气候变暖的程度以及所涉及的农作物种类，但总体而言，"超过30℃左右的温度对农作物非常不利，"哥伦比亚大学国际与公共事务副教授沃尔夫拉姆·施伦克尔说道。

decrease.sentenceEn: When their hobby was both serious and similar to their job, then spending more time on it actually decreased their work efficiency.
decrease.translationZh: 当他们的爱好既严肃认真又与工作相似时，在爱好上花费更多时间实际上会降低他们的工作效率。
decrease.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

decrease.sentenceEn: He was retired soon after, but his public life and fame by no means decreased with the end of his career.
decrease.translationZh: 不久后它便退役了，但它的公众活动和声望丝毫没有因为职业生涯的结束而减退。
decrease.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

decrease.sentenceEn: Enrollment in Design and Technology decreased by nearly ten percent last year in the UK.
decrease.translationZh: 去年英国的设计与技术专业入学人数下降了近10%。

decrease.sentenceEn: Too many choices decrease one's desire to buy.
decrease.translationZh: 选择过多会降低购买欲望。

distance.sentenceEn: Unlike bats, birds and fish, however, humans have difficulty judging distances behind them.
distance.translationZh: 然而，与蝙蝠、鸟类和鱼类不同，人类很难判断身后的距离。

distance.sentenceEn: To address that weakness, Horn is now working with the car company Toyota to enable a form of bilateral control via modifications to existing adaptive cruise control systems, which use forward-facing sensors to judge the distance to the vehicle ahead.
distance.translationZh: 为解决这一缺陷，霍恩目前正与丰田汽车公司合作，通过修改现有的自适应巡航控制系统来实现一种双向控制。该系统利用前向传感器判断与前车的距离。

distance.sentenceEn: The bilateral control approach would include adding rear-facing sensors to determine the distance to the vehicle following a car.
distance.translationZh: 双边控制方法将包括添加后视传感器，以确定与跟随车辆的距离。

distance.sentenceEn: M: Well, the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance .
distance.translationZh: 嗯，节目里的专家确实引用了支持她建议的研究，所以我想下次飞长途的时候我会试一试。
distance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

distance.sentenceEn: Two sets of sensors would be used to help drivers determine the distances between cars.
distance.translationZh: 将使用两套传感器来帮助驾驶员判断车辆之间的距离。

diabetes.sentenceEn: Over time, this mechanism can wear out, increasing the risk of developing type 2 diabetes .
diabetes.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，这种机制可能会逐渐失效，从而增加患2型糖尿病的风险。

diabetes.sentenceEn: Another study found a relationship between fruit juice and type 2 diabetes after following the diets and diabetes status of more than 70,000 nurses over 18 years.
diabetes.translationZh: 另一项研究对7万多名护士进行了18年的饮食和糖尿病状况追踪，发现果汁与2型糖尿病之间存在关联。

diabetes.sentenceEn: Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes , and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
diabetes.translationZh: 高纤维饮食与降低患心脏病、中风、高血压和糖尿病的风险有关，建议成年人每天摄入30克纤维。

diabetes.sentenceEn: In 2013, researchers analysed the health data of 100,000 people collected between 1986 and 2009 and found that fruit juice consumption was linked with increased risk of type 2 diabetes .
diabetes.translationZh: 2013年，研究人员分析了1986年至2009年间收集的10万人健康数据，发现饮用果汁与2型糖尿病风险增加有关联。

diabetes.sentenceEn: So while we know that fruit juice can cause diabetes if it's part of a diet that has more calories overall, it's less clear how juice affects the long-term health of those who aren't overweight.
diabetes.translationZh: 因此，虽然我们知道如果果汁是总体热量较高饮食的一部分，它可能会导致糖尿病，但对于体重正常的人群来说，果汁如何影响其长期健康则不太明确。

diabetes.sentenceEn: Diets containing large amounts of fibre reduce the risk of heart disease, diabetes and other health hazards.
diabetes.translationZh: 富含大量纤维的饮食可降低患心脏病、糖尿病和其他健康风险的几率。

definitely.sentenceEn: Tariq said, "Not everyone has to like corn, but everyone should definitely try it, especially with butter."
definitely.translationZh: 塔里克说：“不一定每个人都得喜欢玉米，但每个人绝对都应该尝尝，尤其是抹上黄油的时候。”

donate.translationZh: 你可以观看如何创业的在线课程，或者阅读关于发展中国家重大灾难的文章，但除非你真正去创业或向需要帮助的人捐款，否则这些知识都是无用的。

donate.sentenceEn: To date, ReBicycle has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need, and is now expanding bike-riding lessons as demand soars.
donate.translationZh: 迄今为止，ReBicycle已向有需要的人士捐赠了200多辆自行车，并且随着需求激增，目前正在扩大自行车骑行课程的规模。
donate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

donate.sentenceEn: They also donated space for 3.1 million pounds of charitable shipping globally.
donate.translationZh: 他们还捐赠了运输空间，用于全球范围内310万磅慈善物资的运输。

donate.sentenceEn: What motivates people to donate in a crowdfunding campaign?
donate.translationZh: 是什么促使人们在众筹活动中捐款？

donate.sentenceEn: It donates regularly to a local charity.
donate.translationZh: 它定期向当地一家慈善机构捐款。

defense.sentenceEn: Do you enjoy unusual puzzle games like Portal, or tower defence games like Defense Grid?
defense.translationZh: 你是否喜欢像《传送门》这样不落俗套的谜题游戏，或是像《防御阵型》这样的塔防游戏？

defense.sentenceEn: Tooth pain is a defense mechanism that ensures when a tooth is being damaged we'll notice and do something about it.
defense.translationZh: 牙齿疼痛是一种防御机制，它能确保当牙齿受到损伤时，我们会注意到并采取相应措施。
defense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

defense.sentenceEn: Cooking real food is the best defense —not to mention that any meal you're likely to eat at home contains about 200 fewer calories than one you would eat in a restaurant.
defense.translationZh: 烹饪真正的食物是最好的防护措施——更不用说，你在家吃的任何一餐都可能比在餐馆吃的少约200卡路里。

defense.sentenceEn: Making is available to ordinary people who aren't tied to big companies, big defense labs or research universities.
defense.translationZh: 创客运动面向的是普通人，他们不必隶属于大公司、大型国防实验室或研究型大学。

defense.sentenceEn: And, though the system was built mostly to make car travel easier, defense was not forgotten.
defense.translationZh: 而且，尽管修建这一系统主要是为了方便汽车出行，但国防因素并未被忽略。
defense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第13句

defense.sentenceEn: In those years, just after World War I, the military wanted to build an American highway system for national defense .
defense.translationZh: 在那些年代，即第一次世界大战刚刚结束后，军方希望建设一个美国公路系统以用于国防。
defense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

distraction.sentenceEn: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher.
distraction.translationZh: 传统上，采用排状排布及其向“U”型布局的微调，旨在最大程度地提高学生的专注度，并减少对教师教学的干扰。
distraction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

distraction.sentenceEn: Or, if the message is presented while the vehicle is in motion, it could represent a distraction .
distraction.translationZh: 或者，如果在车辆行驶过程中显示该消息，则可能会分散驾驶员的注意力。
distraction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

distraction.sentenceEn: It also provides a great opportunity to bond with friends and family, far away from electronics and other distractions at home.
distraction.translationZh: 散步还为你提供了与朋友和家人增进感情的绝佳机会，让你们远离家中的电子设备和其他令人分心的事物。
distraction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

distraction.sentenceEn: This is precisely why parents still need to set firm boundaries around it, as with any other distraction .
distraction.translationZh: 这正是为什么父母仍然需要像对待其他任何干扰一样，为社交媒体使用设定明确的界限。

distraction.sentenceEn: Distraction is also a serious issue.
distraction.translationZh: 分心也是一个严重问题。

distraction.sentenceEn: She regards smartphones as a distraction .
distraction.translationZh: 她认为智能手机会分散注意力。

domestic.sentenceEn: Like domestic labor, emotional labor is generally dismissed and not labeled work.
domestic.translationZh: 与家务劳动一样，情感劳动通常也不被重视，不被视为真正的工作。

domestic.sentenceEn: For example, the United Nations reported that women do nearly three times as much unpaid domestic work as men.
domestic.translationZh: 例如，联合国报告称，女性从事的无偿家务劳动量几乎是男性的三倍。

domestic.sentenceEn: As the scholar Silvia Federici put it in 1975, the unpaid nature of domestic work reinforces the assumption that "housework is not work, thus preventing women from struggling against it."
domestic.translationZh: 正如学者西尔维娅·费德里奇在1975年所指出的，家务劳动的无偿性质强化了'家务不是工作'这一观念，从而阻碍了女性对此进行抗争。

domestic.sentenceEn: The principal aim is to create a home-like relaxing feel, so airlines tend to use soft colors that feel domestic , natural and earthy for that reason.
domestic.translationZh: 其主要目的是营造一种如家般的放松感，因此航空公司倾向于使用柔和的色调，这些颜色给人以居家、自然和朴实的感觉。
domestic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

domestic.sentenceEn: What might affect Japanese domestic produce?
domestic.translationZh: 什么可能会影响日本国内农产品？

domestic.sentenceEn: It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.
domestic.translationZh: 该航空公司的两个国内航班出现了混淆。

drawing.sentenceEn: Rather than shutting down the habit of drawing in his school's workbook, Joe's parents decided to encourage his creativity by sending their son to an after-school art class.
drawing.translationZh: 乔的父母没有制止他在学校练习本上画画的习惯，而是决定鼓励他的创造力，送他去参加课后美术班。
drawing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

drawing.sentenceEn: And finally in tonight's news, a 9-year-old boy named Joe, told not to draw in class, wins a job decorating a restaurant with his drawings .
drawing.translationZh: 最后是今晚的新闻：一名名叫乔的9岁男孩，在课堂上被老师制止画画，却赢得了一份用自己的画作装饰餐厅的工作。
drawing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

drawing.sentenceEn: A restaurant named "Number 4" in Newcastle contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the 9-year-old could come and decorate its dining-room with his drawings .
drawing.translationZh: 纽卡斯尔一家名为“4号”的餐厅联系了乔的老师，询问这位9岁男孩是否能来用餐厅的墙面绘制他的画作。
drawing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

drawing.sentenceEn: But drawing is definitely what he is most passionate about.
drawing.translationZh: 但画画绝对是他最热爱的事情。
drawing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

drawing.sentenceEn: His manuals including The Royal Parisian Baker and the massive five-volume Art of French Cooking Series (1833-1847, completed after his death) first systematized many basic principles of cooking, complete with drawings and step-by-step directions.
drawing.translationZh: 他的烹饪手册，包括《皇家巴黎烘焙师》以及鸿篇巨制的五卷本《法国烹饪艺术大全》（1833-1847年，在他去世后完成），首次将众多烹饪基本原理系统化，并配有插图和详细的分步指导。

drawing.sentenceEn: Help him post his drawings online.
drawing.translationZh: 帮他把画作发布到网上

depressed.sentenceEn: Kate was depressed at first, but then she sat with some girl patients and they opened up all the boxes together, laughing and playing.
depressed.translationZh: 凯特起初很沮丧，但后来她和一些女患儿坐在一起，她们一起打开了所有的盒子，笑着玩耍。
depressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

depressed.sentenceEn: Not only can walking make you less depressed , but according to a new study, depression sufferers who took a daily walk showed just as much improvement in their symptoms as people taking medicine.
depressed.translationZh: 散步不仅能减轻抑郁情绪，一项新研究还显示，每天散步的抑郁症患者在症状改善方面与服药者效果相当。
depressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

depressed.sentenceEn: In fact, 60-70 percent of the participants in the study could no longer even be classified as depressed .
depressed.translationZh: 事实上，该研究中60-70%的参与者甚至已不再被归类为抑郁症患者。
depressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

depressed.sentenceEn: "We do still need the human touch or the human interaction, particularly when people are depressed ."
depressed.translationZh: 我们仍然需要人与人之间的接触和互动，尤其是在人们患有抑郁症时。
depressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

depressed.sentenceEn: While they sound efficient and cost-saving, a recent study reports that they are not effective, primarily because depressed patients are not likely to engage with them or stick with them.
depressed.translationZh: 虽然这些在线抑郁治疗项目听起来高效且节省成本，但最近的一项研究表明它们并不有效，主要原因是抑郁症患者不太可能参与其中或坚持使用。
depressed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

depressed.sentenceEn: People who look at the dark side of life often feel depressed .
depressed.translationZh: 总是看到生活阴暗面的人常常感到抑郁。

depth.sentenceEn: If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities, we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths .
depth.translationZh: 如果我们将注意力转向培养内在品质，或许会发现一种强大的吸引力，引导我们从表面的事物走向能与我们内心深处相连的东西。
depth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

depth.sentenceEn: "Many people see team-building activities as a waste of time, so we decided to look in more depth at what's behind this," said the paper's lead researcher, Dr. Peter Matous.
depth.translationZh: 该论文的首席研究员彼得·马图什博士表示：“许多人将团建活动视为浪费时间，因此我们决定更深入地探究这一现象背后的原因。”
depth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

depth.sentenceEn: They are not designed for students to interact with the material in depth but designed to be graded easily to accommodate such a large number of students.
depth.translationZh: 这些作业的设计目的并非让学生深入理解学习内容，而是为了便于评分，以适应如此众多的学生。
depth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

depth.sentenceEn: If we are to truly understand how much our cognitive lives differ cross-culturally, we must continually explore the depths of our species' linguistic diversity.
depth.translationZh: 如果我们想要真正理解不同文化背景下人们的认知生活存在多大差异，就必须不断探索人类语言多样性的深度。

depth.sentenceEn: You'll find depth that you won't get from your screen no matter how many likes you get on your post.
depth.translationZh: 你会发现屏幕无法给予你的深度连接，无论你的帖子获得多少点赞。
depth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

depth.sentenceEn: Even though pumping from these depths is expensive, it is still cheaper than desalinating(脱盐) the ocean water in the largely coastal state.
depth.translationZh: 尽管从这些深度抽水成本高昂，但对于这个以沿海地区为主的州而言，仍比海水脱盐更为经济。
depth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dietary.sentenceEn: Freshly juiced fruit has become a basic dietary item—especially for busy, health-conscious consumers who can save time on making (and perhaps even chewing) their food without missing out on nutrients.
dietary.translationZh: 鲜榨果汁已成为基本饮食项目——尤其受到忙碌且注重健康的消费者青睐，他们可以节省制作（甚至咀嚼）食物的时间，同时又不会错过营养。

dietary.sentenceEn: In the 1970s through the 1990s, protein products remained visible but moved back somewhat with the dietary spotlight firmly fixed on low-calorie, low-fat, sugar-free snack foods and beverages following the publication of studies linking sugar and saturated(饱和的) fat consumption to heart disease.
dietary.translationZh: 20世纪70年代至90年代，蛋白质产品虽仍有市场，但关注度有所下降，因为多项研究表明糖和饱和脂肪的摄入与心脏病有关，此后低热量、低脂肪、无糖的零食和饮料成为饮食界的焦点。
dietary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

dietary.sentenceEn: The researchers also were not able to adjust for certain lifestyle factors that could affect lifespan, including dietary habits and changes in physical activity over time.
dietary.translationZh: 研究人员也无法对某些可能影响寿命的生活方式因素进行调整，包括饮食习惯和不同时期体力活动的变化。
dietary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

dietary.sentenceEn: Low-income households report that they find it difficult to adopt dietary guidelines because food prices are a barrier to improving their diets.
dietary.translationZh: 低收入家庭表示，他们发现很难采用膳食指南，因为食品价格是改善其饮食的一大障碍。
dietary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

dietary.sentenceEn: These dietary differences are often accompanied by higher rates of obesity and diabetes among lower-income people.
dietary.translationZh: 这些饮食差异通常伴随着低收入人群中更高的肥胖和糖尿病发病率。
dietary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dietary.sentenceEn: Dietary recommendations are not fit for underprivileged people.
dietary.translationZh: 膳食建议并不适合贫困人群。

discipline.sentenceEn: The concept has been applied to a wide range of disciplines , from developmental psychology to economics and engineering.
discipline.translationZh: 这一概念已被广泛应用于多个学科领域，从发展心理学到经济学和工程学。
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

discipline.sentenceEn: People with a great amount of willpower have the discipline to develop positive, successful habits.
discipline.translationZh: 拥有强大意志力的人能够通过自律养成积极且成功的习惯。
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

discipline.sentenceEn: Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.
discipline.translationZh: 即使拥有惊人的天赋，若缺乏培养积极习惯的自律和动力，也难以取得成功。
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

discipline.sentenceEn: "We're not trying to assign blame or criticize anyone or call anyone consciously sexist. Rather, the point is to use the results of this study to open up meaningful dialogues on implicit gender bias, be it at a departmental level or an institutional level or even a discipline level," which may lead to some recommendations for the letter writers themselves.
discipline.translationZh: 「我们并非试图归咎责任、批评任何人或指责谁有意识地存在性别歧视。相反，我们的目的是利用这项研究结果，就隐性性别偏见展开有意义的对话——无论是在系级、机构层面，还是甚至在学科层面——这可能会为推荐信撰写者本身提供一些建议。」
discipline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

discipline.sentenceEn: Associating, he adds, is the ability to make idea-producing connections by linking concepts from different disciplines .
discipline.translationZh: 他补充道，联想能力是指通过连接不同学科的概念来建立能够产生新想法的关联的能力。

discipline.sentenceEn: They strengthened the school's discipline and order.
discipline.translationZh: 他们加强了学校的纪律和秩序。

disorder.sentenceEn: Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder .
disorder.translationZh: 因此，他们认为将电脑游戏成瘾称为一种疾病还为时过早。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

disorder.sentenceEn: This behavior can become a disorder .
disorder.translationZh: 这种行为可能发展成一种障碍。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

disorder.sentenceEn: "It's been well documented in extensive research over the years that prevalence rates for the majority of the anxiety disorders are higher in women than men."
disorder.translationZh: 多年来的大量研究已充分证明，大多数焦虑症在女性中的患病率高于男性。

disorder.sentenceEn: To treat the disorder , there are a number of medicines and therapies that are backed by rigorous research, according to the American Academy of Sleep Medicine, which analyzed the available research on the treatment of nightmare disorder in a recent review published in the Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine.
disorder.translationZh: 美国睡眠医学学会在近期发表于《临床睡眠医学杂志》的一篇综述中分析了关于噩梦障碍治疗的现有研究。该学会表示，有多种药物和疗法的有效性已得到严格研究的支持，可用于治疗这种障碍。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

disorder.sentenceEn: However, nightmares are complicated, and researchers are still struggling to understand them, said Dr. Rachel Salas, an expert on sleep disorders and an associate professor at Johns Hopkins Medicine in Baltimore.
disorder.translationZh: 然而，巴尔的摩约翰·霍普金斯医学院的睡眠障碍专家、副教授雷切尔·萨拉斯博士表示，噩梦十分复杂，研究人员仍在努力理解它们。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

disorder.sentenceEn: They can just be symptoms of a sleep disorder that can result from an unpleasant experience, stress, or certain drugs.
disorder.translationZh: 它们可能只是某种睡眠障碍的症状，这类睡眠障碍可能由不愉快的经历、压力或某些药物引起。
disorder.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

dramatic.sentenceEn: There was a 50% drop in medical prescriptions along with a dramatic decrease in death rates—but most importantly, the residents were simply happier.
dramatic.translationZh: 医疗处方量下降了50%，死亡率也大幅降低——但最重要的是，老人们真的变得更快乐了。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句
文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

dramatic.sentenceEn: Consider that nearly two-thirds of students will experience the "ninth-grade shock," which refers to a dramatic drop in a student's academic performance.
dramatic.translationZh: 要知道，近三分之二的学生会经历“九年级冲击”，即学生的学业成绩出现急剧下降。

dramatic.sentenceEn: Perhaps the most dramatic impact is the reduction in the amount of sleep, which leads to poor health and weight gain.
dramatic.translationZh: 或许最显著的影响是睡眠量的减少，这会导致健康状况不佳和体重增加。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

dramatic.sentenceEn: This turn of events is fueled primarily by the dramatic drop in the share of young Americans who are choosing to settle down romantically before age 35.
dramatic.translationZh: 这一局面的转变主要是由于选择在35岁之前建立浪漫关系并安定下来的美国年轻人比例大幅下降。

dramatic.sentenceEn: According to the passage, what is the most dramatic impact of smartphone use?
dramatic.translationZh: 根据文章，智能手机使用最显著的影响是什么？

drought.sentenceEn: Like Farrant's work with resurrection crops, a number of companies, organisations and researchers are aiming to create drought and temperature-resistant crops through genetic engineering and conventional breeding.
drought.translationZh: 与法兰特在复活植物方面的研究类似，许多公司、组织和研究人员正致力于通过基因工程和传统育种技术培育耐旱耐温作物。

drought.sentenceEn: Last week, BBC Future explored one scientist's efforts to help crops cope with the increased probability of droughts .
drought.translationZh: 上周，BBC《未来》栏目探讨了一位科学家为帮助作物应对日益增加的干旱可能性所做的努力。

drought.sentenceEn: While this can be good news for the world's poorest people who now consume more calories, protein and fat than in the past, homogeneity(同一性) and over-dependence on a handful of staples leave us vulnerable to threats such as drought , disease and pests—all of which are predicted to worsen in many parts of the world as a result of climate change.
drought.translationZh: 虽然这对世界上最贫困的人群来说可能是个好消息——他们现在摄入的热量、蛋白质和脂肪比过去都有所增加，但饮食的同一性以及对少数几种主食的过度依赖，使我们容易受到干旱、疾病和虫害等威胁的影响。而气候变化预计将导致这些威胁在世界许多地区进一步加剧。

drought.sentenceEn: Under current conditions, about 4% of the world's croplands experience drought in any given year, but by the end of the century those conditions are forecasted to jump to about 18% per year.
drought.translationZh: 在当前情况下，全球约4%的农田每年都会遭遇干旱，但到本世纪末，预计这一比例将跃升至每年约18%。

drought.sentenceEn: A recent news report talked about scientific efforts to help crops survive droughts through genetic engineering.
drought.translationZh: 最近一则新闻报道了通过基因工程帮助作物抵御干旱的科学努力。

drought.sentenceEn: They are the ultimate solution to droughts .
drought.translationZh: 它们是干旱的终极解决方案。

decorate.sentenceEn: A restaurant named "Number 4" in Newcastle contacted Joe's teacher to ask if the 9-year-old could come and decorate its dining-room with his drawings.
decorate.translationZh: 纽卡斯尔一家名为“4号”的餐厅联系了乔的老师，询问这位9岁男孩是否能来用餐厅的墙面绘制他的画作。
decorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

decorate.sentenceEn: And finally in tonight's news, a 9-year-old boy named Joe, told not to draw in class, wins a job decorating a restaurant with his drawings.

decorate.translationZh: 而且这座建筑的部分墙壁上装饰着珠宝。

decorate.sentenceEn: A decorated egg thrown into the field would be a wish for a good harvest.
decorate.translationZh: 将彩蛋抛入田野，是祈求丰收的美好愿望。
decorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

decorate.translationZh: 查斯特为什么喜欢装饰鸡蛋的过程？

deny.translationZh: 他否认该决定剥夺了孩子们享受雪景的机会。

deny.sentenceEn: They are often denied crucial information the web offers many others.
deny.translationZh: 他们往往无法获取网络为其他人提供的关键信息。

deny.sentenceEn: I personally feel sorry for the poor animals stuck in cages, but there's no denying they are fun and educational for children.
deny.translationZh: 我个人其实挺同情那些被关在笼子里的可怜动物的，但不可否认的是，动物园对孩子们来说既有趣又有教育意义。
deny.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

deny.sentenceEn: In May, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) and Outten & Golden LLP announced a historic class-action $5m settlement with JPMorgan Chase on behalf of male employees who claim they were illegally denied access to paid parental leave.
deny.translationZh: 今年5月，美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）与Outten & Golden律师事务所代表那些声称被非法剥夺带薪育儿假权利的男性员工，宣布与摩根大通达成一项历史性的集体诉讼和解协议，金额达500万美元。

deny.sentenceEn: Few would deny that too much time online can be harmful.
deny.translationZh: 几乎没有人会否认，过多的上网时间可能有害。

deny.sentenceEn: Deny them access to any food.
deny.translationZh: 不要让它们接触到任何食物。

dependent.sentenceEn: But 64% of the young adults surveyed said parents' financial support to children age 25 to 34 is "a bad thing", because it makes those kids dependent .
dependent.translationZh: 但64%的受访年轻人认为，父母向25至34岁的子女提供经济支持是“一件坏事”，因为这会使这些孩子产生依赖性。
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dependent.sentenceEn: This need to be liked can be traced back to when we were children and were completely dependent on others to take care of us: Small children are not just learning how to walk and communicate, they are also trying to learn how the world works.
dependent.translationZh: 这种渴望被他人喜欢的需求可以追溯到我们还是孩子、完全依赖他人照顾的时期：小孩子不仅在学习走路和交流，他们也在努力了解世界是如何运作的。
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

dependent.sentenceEn: However, where we get into trouble is when our self-worth is dependent upon whether we win someone's approval or not.
dependent.translationZh: 然而，当我们的自我价值取决于能否赢得他人认可时，问题就出现了。
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

dependent.sentenceEn: In their 2020 study, the researchers interviewed nearly 80 employees at two London-based firms—an equal number of men and women between the ages of 30 and 50, all with at least one dependent child—who worked in middle or senior management roles.
dependent.translationZh: 在2020年的研究中，研究人员采访了伦敦两家公司的近80名员工——男女各占一半，年龄在30至50岁之间，均至少有一个需要抚养的子女——这些人担任中层或高层管理职位。

dependent.sentenceEn: I'm very much dependent on vision as a way of taking in information.
dependent.translationZh: 我非常依赖视觉来接收信息。
dependent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

dependent.sentenceEn: He wanted to be less dependent on his phone.
dependent.translationZh: 他想减少对手机的依赖。

derive.sentenceEn: These top earners derive meaning from their jobs and work is an important part of how they think of themselves.
derive.translationZh: 这些高收入者从工作中获得意义，工作是他们自我认知的重要组成部分。

derive.sentenceEn: Because the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not defined the term, companies can use it to refer to pretty much anything derived from a plant or animal.
derive.translationZh: 由于美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）尚未对该术语进行定义，各公司几乎可以用它来指代任何源自植物或动物的物质。
derive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

derive.sentenceEn: This is why the word "five" in many languages is derived from the word for "hand."
derive.translationZh: 这就是为什么在许多语言中，'五'这个词都源自表示'手'的词。

derive.sentenceEn: Whether it's rough physical play, outdoor play or social or pretend play, kids derive important lessons from the chance to make things up as they go, he said.
derive.translationZh: 他说，无论是剧烈的肢体游戏、户外游戏，还是社交游戏或假装游戏，孩子们都能从这种即兴发挥的机会中获得重要的经验教训。

derive.sentenceEn: What distinguishes children from adults is their strong ability to derive joy from what they are doing.
derive.translationZh: 儿童与成人的区别在于他们从所做之事中获取快乐的强大能力。

derive.sentenceEn: They derive greater pleasure from buying things.
derive.translationZh: 他们从购物中获得了更大的乐趣。

description.sentenceEn: They found that participants in a high-power interviewer role were more likely to give abstract descriptions of behaviors than were participants in a low-power interviewee role.
description.translationZh: 他们发现，扮演高权力面试官角色的参与者比扮演低权力受访者角色的参与者更有可能对行为给出抽象描述。
description.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

description.sentenceEn: But contrary to popular belief, the homeless in Los Angeles are not mostly mentally ill or drug addicted or frightening, although a sizable minority meet some of those descriptions .
description.translationZh: 但与普遍看法相反，洛杉矶的无家可归者并非大多患有精神疾病、吸毒成瘾或具有威胁性，尽管有相当一部分人符合其中某些描述。
description.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

description.sentenceEn: If asked, most people will be able to give a vague description of their main meals: breakfast, lunch, dinner.
description.translationZh: 如果被问到，大多数人能够模糊地描述出他们的正餐：早餐、午餐、晚餐。
description.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

description.sentenceEn: And then under the description of your personal information, you should see an option for updating payment methods.
description.translationZh: 然后在您的个人信息页面下，您应该能看到更新付款方式的选项。
description.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

description.sentenceEn: What do we learn about Dan from the man's description ?
description.translationZh: 从男士的描述中，我们了解到丹的哪些情况？

description.sentenceEn: They seldom meet the descriptions of homelessness.
description.translationZh: 他们很少符合这些对无家可归者的描述。

discourage.sentenceEn: Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around.
discourage.translationZh: 工作人员尽力阻止那只宠物在附近逗留。
discourage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

discourage.sentenceEn: A rich social life, these studies suggest, can lower stress levels, improve mood, encourage positive health behaviors and discourage damaging ones, boost heart health and improve illness recovery rates.
discourage.translationZh: 这些研究表明，丰富的社交生活有助于减轻压力、改善情绪、促进积极健康的行为、抑制有害健康的行为、增强心脏健康并提高疾病康复率。
discourage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

discourage.sentenceEn: It's illegal to get within 1,500 feet of the animals without a federal research permit, so whale watchers are discouraged from attempting to get close to the whales.
discourage.translationZh: 未经联邦研究许可，接近这些鲸鱼1500英尺（约457米）范围内属于违法行为，因此不鼓励观鲸者尝试靠近它们。
discourage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

discourage.sentenceEn: Meanwhile there are complaints that poor service at London's major airports is discouraging foreigners from doing business in Britain.
discourage.translationZh: 与此同时，有人抱怨伦敦主要机场的服务质量低劣，这正阻碍外国人来英国开展业务。
discourage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

discourage.sentenceEn: Playing with digital devices discourages kids from active discovery, according to pediatrician Dr. Michael Yogman.
discourage.translationZh: 儿科医生迈克尔·约格曼博士表示，玩数字设备会阻碍孩子主动探索发现。

discourage.sentenceEn: We will be discouraged from revealing our true selves.
discourage.translationZh: 我们会不敢展现真实的自我。

discrimination.sentenceEn: Derek Rotondo, 35, filed the discrimination charge against his company after he was allegedly told by his HR department that mothers were considered primary caregivers.
discrimination.translationZh: 35岁的德里克·罗通多（Derek Rotondo）对其公司提起歧视诉讼，据称他的人力资源部门告知他，母亲被视为主要照顾者。

discrimination.sentenceEn: Yet numberless people struggle with tasks that require precise discrimination between quantities.
discrimination.translationZh: 然而，没有数字概念的人在需要精确区分数量的任务上会遇到困难。

discrimination.sentenceEn: Recognising obesity as a chronic disease with severe complications rather than a lifestyle choice "should help reduce the stigma(耻辱) and discrimination experienced by many people with obesity," he adds.
discrimination.translationZh: 他补充道，将肥胖视为一种伴有严重并发症的慢性疾病，而非生活方式的选择，"有助于减轻许多肥胖者所遭受的耻辱和歧视。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Michigan is the only state that prohibits discrimination on the basis of weight and height.
discrimination.translationZh: 密歇根州是唯一一个禁止基于体重和身高进行歧视的州。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

discrimination.sentenceEn: Since employers' perception of weight is what matters in the labor market, changing discrimination laws to include body type as a category would also help.
discrimination.translationZh: 鉴于雇主对体重的看法是劳动力市场中的关键因素，修改反歧视法律，将体型纳入保护范畴也会有所助益。
discrimination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

discrimination.sentenceEn: There is discrimination against male nurses.
discrimination.translationZh: 社会上对男护士存在歧视。

deadly.sentenceEn: A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo, has slipped away for the second time.
deadly.translationZh: 一条致命毒蛇在从动物园逃脱后终于被追踪到，却再次溜走了。
deadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

deadly.sentenceEn: This kind of snake is one of the most deadly and poisonous in the wild, and they can range from 3 to 5 meters in length.
deadly.translationZh: 这种蛇是野外最致命、最毒的蛇类之一，体长可达3至5米。
deadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deadly.sentenceEn: Native to the South Pacific and Indian Ocean, the potentially deadly fish has poisonous hooks and a painful sting capable of killing people.
deadly.translationZh: 这种具有潜在致命危险的鱼类原产于南太平洋和印度洋，长有毒钩，其蛰刺疼痛难忍，可致人死亡。
deadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

deadly.sentenceEn: Tourism throughout Turkey is expected to fall this year as the country has been the victim of several deadly terrorist attacks.
deadly.translationZh: 由于土耳其遭遇了多起致命的恐怖袭击，今年该国的旅游业预计将会下滑。
deadly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

deadly.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the deadly snake from the news report?
deadly.translationZh: 从新闻报道中我们了解到关于这种致命蛇类的哪些信息？

deadly.sentenceEn: A deadly fish has been spotted in the Mediterranean waters.
deadly.translationZh: 地中海海域发现了一种致命鱼类。

deficiency.sentenceEn: Physicians in the U.S. have never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency because simply by eating an adequate number of daily calories we are also most likely getting enough protein.
deficiency.translationZh: 美国医生从未真正诊治过蛋白质缺乏的患者，因为只要每日摄入足够的热量，我们很可能就已经获得了充足的蛋白质。
deficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

deficiency.sentenceEn: Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts.
deficiency.translationZh: 生活在大多数发达国家的我们许多人，正被食品公司和自封的健康专家制造的蛋白质缺乏神话所迷惑。
deficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deficiency.sentenceEn: Humble people do not ignore, avoid, or try to deny their limits or deficiencies .
deficiency.translationZh: 谦逊的人不会忽视、回避或试图否认自己的局限或不足。
deficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

deficiency.sentenceEn: Being humble means you have the ability to accurately assess your deficiencies without denying your skills and strengths.
deficiency.translationZh: 谦逊意味着你有能力准确评估自己的不足，同时又不否认自己的技能和优势。
deficiency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

deficiency.sentenceEn: Why have physicians in the U.S. never actually examined a patient with protein deficiency ?
deficiency.translationZh: 为什么美国医生从未真正检查过蛋白质缺乏症患者？

deficiency.sentenceEn: Americans can rely on food supplements to prevent protein deficiency .
deficiency.translationZh: 美国人可以依靠膳食补充剂来预防蛋白质缺乏。

devote.sentenceEn: Scientists have known that depriving adult mice of vision can increase the sensitivity of individual neurons(神经元) in the part of the brain devoted to hearing.
devote.translationZh: 科学家们已经发现，剥夺成年小鼠的视觉会提高其大脑听觉区域单个神经元的敏感性。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

devote.sentenceEn: Kanold's earlier research disproved this idea by showing that depriving adult mice of vision for a short period increased the sensitivity of individual neurons in the auditory cortex(皮质), which is devoted to hearing.
devote.translationZh: 卡诺尔德早期的研究反驳了这一观点，他通过实验表明，短期剥夺成年小鼠的视觉会提高听觉皮质中单个神经元的敏感性，而听觉皮质正是负责处理听觉信息的区域。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

devote.sentenceEn: Much of that time is devoted to text messages and social media.
devote.translationZh: 其中大部分时间都用于发送短信和使用社交媒体。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

devote.sentenceEn: Then I can devote more time and energy to finding a better position at another company.
devote.translationZh: 这样我就能把更多时间和精力投入到寻找另一家公司的更好职位上了。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

devote.sentenceEn: Since the adoption of sweeping education reforms in 2001, public schools have steadily increased the amount of time devoted to preparing for standardized tests.
devote.translationZh: 自2001年大规模教育改革实施以来，公立学校用于准备标准化考试的时间持续增加。

devote.sentenceEn: Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games.
devote.translationZh: 组织者为赛事倾注了大量时间和精力。

dining.sentenceEn: The fine dining establishment received its first three-star Michelin rating in 2011 when the menu was famed for its fancy animal-based dishes.
dining.translationZh: 这家高级餐厅在 2011 年获得了首个米其林三星评级，当时的菜单以其精致的肉食料理而闻名。
dining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dining.sentenceEn: "We took the jump to transform Eleven Madison Park into a plant-based fine dining restaurant knowing in our hearts this is what we believed in," stated Humm on Instagram.
dining.translationZh: 胡姆在 Instagram 上表示：“我们将 Eleven Madison Park 转型为一家纯素食高端餐厅，这一决定虽然冒险，但我们内心深处深信这是正确的方向。”
dining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

dining.sentenceEn: Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it 'a bold vision of luxury dining '.
dining.translationZh: 现在，这一令人瞩目的新成就肯定了 Eleven Madison Park 餐厅将肉类移出菜单并拥抱植物性饮食的决定，米其林 2022 纽约指南也将其誉为‘对奢华餐饮的大胆愿景’。
dining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

dining.sentenceEn: What's more, homes built in the 2000s were more likely than earlier models to have more of all types of spaces: bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, recreation rooms and garages.
dining.translationZh: 更重要的是，21世纪初建造的房屋比早期的房屋更有可能拥有更多种类的空间：卧室、浴室、客厅、餐厅、娱乐室和车库。
dining.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

dining.sentenceEn: But in the very beginning, there was just Carême, the top chef who elevated dining into art.
dining.translationZh: 但追根溯源，一切始于卡雷姆——这位将烹饪提升至艺术境界的顶级名厨。

dining.sentenceEn: It has banned kids under 10 from dining there.
dining.translationZh: 该店已禁止10岁以下儿童在内用餐。

dioxide.sentenceEn: To turn carbon dioxide into stone, researchers with the CarbFix project pumped the gas into volcanic rock and sped up the natural process, in which the volcanic rock reacts with gas and forms carbon minerals.
dioxide.translationZh: 为了将二氧化碳转化为石头，CarbFix项目的研究人员将气体泵入火山岩中，加速了这一自然过程——在此过程中，火山岩与气体发生反应，形成碳矿物。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

dioxide.sentenceEn: Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
dioxide.translationZh: 冰岛研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法——将二氧化碳泵入地下并将其转化为石头。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

dioxide.sentenceEn: Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas.
dioxide.translationZh: 其他碳捕获与封存方法是将二氧化碳以气体形式储存。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

dioxide.sentenceEn: Already, the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year.
dioxide.translationZh: 目前，冰岛的这一项目已扩大规模，每年可封存10,000吨二氧化碳。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

dioxide.sentenceEn: One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.
dioxide.translationZh: 该技术的一个潜在难点是，每掩埋一吨二氧化碳就需要25吨水。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

dioxide.sentenceEn: This new method of burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone is cheaper and more secure, the Guardian reports.
dioxide.translationZh: 《卫报》报道，这种将二氧化碳深埋并将其转化为石头的新方法成本更低，也更安全。
dioxide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

distribute.sentenceEn: He said the people who should be paying regard to the Wang paper are the funding agents who distribute government grant money.
distribute.translationZh: 他表示，王大顺的论文值得关注的人群是负责分配政府科研基金的资助机构人员。

distribute.translationZh: 他说，在决定谁能获得资助的过程中，人们投入了大量的时间和精力，而最新研究表明，科学界在资金分配方面做得并不出色。

distribute.sentenceEn: There, they keep other creatures in check, distribute seeds, and clean dead and decaying materials from the ground.
distribute.translationZh: 在那里，它们控制着其他生物的数量，传播种子，并清理地面上的死亡和腐烂物质。
distribute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

distribute.sentenceEn: One researcher suggests it might be more fruitful to distribute grants on a relatively equal basis.
distribute.translationZh: 一位研究人员建议，相对平均地分配资助可能会更有成效。
它们能接收到均匀分布的热量。

dreaming.sentenceEn: But scientists believe REM serves a completely different purpose for newborns and infants than dreaming .

dreaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dreaming.sentenceEn: Still, that's not always the case: When roused during REM sleep, 25% of the kids in Foulkes' studies had no recollection of dreaming , a trend that continues through age 9.
dreaming.translationZh: 不过，情况并不总是如此：在福克斯的研究中，当孩子们在快速眼动睡眠期间被唤醒时，25% 的孩子不记得自己做过梦，这种趋势一直持续到 9 岁。
dreaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第7句

dreaming.sentenceEn: Research is limited, but some studies suggest that people who can master lucid dreaming —that is, the ability to be aware that a nightmare is happening and possibly even control it without waking up—may hold the answer.
dreaming.translationZh: 相关研究虽然有限，但一些研究表明，能够掌握清醒梦的人——即能够意识到噩梦正在发生，甚至可能在不醒来的情况下控制噩梦的能力——或许掌握着答案。
dreaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dreaming.sentenceEn: What's more, researchers are coming to recognize that dreaming is an essential part of understanding, organizing and retaining what we learn.
dreaming.translationZh: 此外，研究人员逐渐认识到，做梦是理解、整理和记住所学知识的重要环节。
dreaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

dreaming.sentenceEn: What can be inferred about dreaming from the passage?
dreaming.translationZh: 从文章中可以推断出关于做梦的什么信息？

dreaming.sentenceEn: It is a sign of dreaming in adults and infants alike.
dreaming.translationZh: 它是成年人和婴儿正在做梦的标志。

damaged.sentenceEn: In the late 1960s, British brain scientist Geoffrey Raisman spied growth in damaged brain regions of rats through an electron microscope; their brains were forging new connections.
damaged.translationZh: 20世纪60年代末，英国脑科学家杰弗里·雷斯曼通过电子显微镜观察到大鼠受损脑区出现生长现象；它们的大脑正在形成新的连接。
damaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

damaged.sentenceEn: Fortunately, all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been preserved, so we've been able to replace badly damaged furniture.
damaged.translationZh: 幸运的是，这座建筑及其内部所有物品的设计蓝图都保存了下来，因此我们能够更换那些严重损坏的家具。
damaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

damaged.sentenceEn: Repair of damaged cells takes about two days, and afterwards the soreness disappears.
damaged.translationZh: 受损细胞的修复大约需要两天时间，之后酸痛感便会消失。
damaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第14句

damaged.sentenceEn: Private courier companies, which have more dollars to spend, use their expertise in logistics to help revitalize damaged areas after a disaster.
damaged.translationZh: 拥有更多资金的私营快递公司利用其物流专业知识，帮助灾后受损地区恢复活力。

damaged.sentenceEn: How long does it take for damaged cells to heal?
damaged.translationZh: 受损细胞需要多长时间才能愈合？
将受损的奖牌送去修复。

dislike.sentenceEn: Both groups disliked stuff on their opposite side.
dislike.translationZh: 两组人都不喜欢自己非优势手一侧的图像。
dislike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

dislike.sentenceEn: Others simply dislike the appearance of forests planted in neat rows.
dislike.translationZh: 还有些人就是不喜欢人工种植的整齐排列的森林外观。
dislike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

dislike.sentenceEn: If parents are angered by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
dislike.translationZh: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到愤怒，不喜欢她的新丈夫，也不赞成她养育孙辈的方式，那么他们很可能不会喜欢女儿的来访。
dislike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

dislike.sentenceEn: No longer does a good craftsman have to work in a job he dislikes all day, and then try to create at night.
dislike.translationZh: 优秀的手工艺人不必再整天从事自己不喜欢的工作，然后在晚上才能尝试创作了。
dislike.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

dislike.sentenceEn: Job applicants are advised to make a written list of their likes and dislikes in their previous employment.
dislike.translationZh: 建议求职者将自己对以往工作的好恶之处列成书面清单。

dislike.sentenceEn: They were disliked most by children.
dislike.translationZh: 孩子们最不喜欢胡萝卜。

dispute.sentenceEn: Another role that they are expected to take over is negotiating on our behalf in commercial transactions or legal disputes .
dispute.translationZh: 人们期望人工智能代理接管的另一项任务是代表我们进行商业交易或法律纠纷的谈判。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

dispute.sentenceEn: Men are more likely to face that dispute from the perspective of what benefits them most, whereas women may approach the same dispute from the perspective of what's the easiest and quickest way to resolve the problem—even if that means doing the boring work themselves.
dispute.translationZh: 男性更可能从对自己最有利的角度来面对这种争议，而女性则可能从最简单、最快捷地解决问题的角度来处理同样的争议——即使这意味着要自己做那些枯燥的工作。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

dispute.sentenceEn: For example, there's a problem that needs to be addressed immediately, resulting in a dispute over who should be the one to fix it.
dispute.translationZh: 例如，当某个问题需要立即解决时，就会引发由谁来负责处理的争议。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

dispute.sentenceEn: Disputes were characterised by intense verbal(言语上的) aggression, tended to be repeated and not resolved, and made men, more than women, extremely angry.
dispute.translationZh: 这类争执的特点是激烈的言语攻击，往往反复发生且难以解决，并且相比女性，更容易让男性极度愤怒。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

dispute.sentenceEn: Settle disputes between universities and government agencies.
dispute.translationZh: 解决大学与政府机构之间的分歧

distinction.sentenceEn: Before dipping into some of the key take-aways, an important distinction made in the review is between aerobic exercise and anaerobic.
distinction.translationZh: 在深入探讨一些关键要点之前，本综述中做出的一个重要区分是有氧运动和无氧运动之间的区别。
distinction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

distinction.sentenceEn: In the absence of the cultural traditions that fill our lives with numbers from infancy, we would all struggle with even basic quantitative distinctions .
distinction.translationZh: 如果没有从婴儿时期就用数字充斥我们生活的文化传统，我们所有人甚至连基本的数量区分都会感到困难。

distinction.sentenceEn: We are not born to handle quantitative distinctions skillfully.
distinction.translationZh: 我们并非生来就能熟练地进行数量区分。

distinction.sentenceEn: Such seemingly straightforward distinctions become blurry through numberless eyes.
distinction.translationZh: 在没有数字概念的人眼中，这种看似简单明了的区分变得模糊不清。

distinction.sentenceEn: This and many other experiments have led to a simple conclusion: When people do not have number words, they struggle to make quantitative distinctions that probably seem natural to someone like you or me.
distinction.translationZh: 这项实验及其他多项实验得出了一个简单结论：当人们没有数字词汇时，他们很难做出数量上的区分，而这种区分对于你我这样的人来说似乎是自然而然的。

distinction.sentenceEn: Making quantitative distinctions is not an inborn skill.
distinction.translationZh: 进行数量区分并非与生俱来的技能。

distribution.sentenceEn: The researchers found that, in adult mice, a week in the dark also changed the distribution of space to different frequencies.
distribution.translationZh: 研究人员发现，在成年小鼠中，一周的黑暗环境也改变了空间对不同频率的分布。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

distribution.sentenceEn: We have long feared that this "revolution in distribution " uses corporate black magic on our appetite.
distribution.translationZh: 长期以来，我们一直担心这场'分销革命'会用企业的黑魔法来操控我们的食欲。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

distribution.sentenceEn: Supermarkets may not feel cutting-edge now, but they were a revolution in distribution at the time.
distribution.translationZh: 如今超市或许已不再给人前沿之感，但在当时，它们堪称一场分销革命。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

distribution.sentenceEn: California has been facing a drought for many years now, with certain areas even having to pump freshwater hundreds of miles to their distribution system.
distribution.translationZh: 加利福尼亚州多年来一直面临干旱问题，部分地区甚至不得不将淡水抽取数百英里输送至其供水系统。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

distribution.sentenceEn: Graduation requirements specify the number of credits you must earn, the minimum grade point average you must achieve and the distribution of credits you must have from among differing departments or fields of study.
distribution.translationZh: 毕业要求会明确规定你必须获得的学分数、必须达到的最低平均绩点，以及必须从不同院系或研究领域获得的学分分布。
distribution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第9句

distribution.sentenceEn: They revolutionized the distribution of goods.
distribution.translationZh: 它们彻底改变了商品的分销方式。

dull.sentenceEn: In relation to the intensity of anaerobic exercise, however, the results were far clearer—the optimum(最佳选择) for improving mood is moderate intensity, perhaps because low intensity is too dull while high intensity is too unpleasant.
dull.translationZh: 然而，就无氧运动强度而言，研究结果要明确得多——改善情绪的最佳选择是中等强度，这可能是因为低强度过于枯燥，而高强度又令人不适。
dull.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

dull.sentenceEn: W: How utterly overwhelming and dull !
dull.translationZh: 这真是既让人倍感压力又枯燥乏味啊！
dull.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

dull.sentenceEn: Their job satisfaction, too, can surge when well-functioning machines relieve them of dull tasks or repetitive processes.
dull.translationZh: 当运转良好的机器将他们从枯燥的任务或重复性流程中解放出来时，他们的工作满意度也会大幅提升。
dull.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

dull.sentenceEn: The second is guaranteed to look great for about 10 years, whereas the cheaper one will start to dull after around six or seven years.
dull.translationZh: 贵的那款保证十年内都能保持美观，而便宜的那款大概六七年后就会开始褪色。
dull.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

dull.sentenceEn: Interesting as it might appear, a made-up conversation will probably turn out to be dull .
dull.translationZh: 虚构的对话或许看似有趣，但最终很可能索然无味。

dull.sentenceEn: It dulls a leader's sense of urgency.
dull.translationZh: 这会削弱领导者的紧迫感。

deed.sentenceEn: A man passing by decided to video their good deed and put it on the internet.
deed.translationZh: 一名路过的男子决定将他们的善举拍摄下来并发布到互联网上。
deed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

deed.sentenceEn: I think what Aesop was suggesting is that when you offer a good turn to another human being, one can hope that that good deed will come back and sort of pay a profit to you, the doer of the good deed .
deed.translationZh: 我认为伊索想要表达的是，当你对他人施以援手时，你可以期待这一善举会有所回报，给行善者你带来某种益处。

deed.sentenceEn: Even if there is no concrete benefit paid in response to your good deed , at the very least, the doer of the good deed has the opportunity to enjoy a kind of spiritually enlightened moment.
deed.translationZh: 即便你的善举没有带来任何实质性回报，至少行善者能有机会享受一种精神上的顿悟时刻。

deed.sentenceEn: Who put the good deed video on the internet?
deed.translationZh: 谁将这一善举的视频传到了互联网上？

deed.sentenceEn: The tourists' good deed was not noticed by the locals.
deed.translationZh: 游客们的善举并未引起当地人的注意。

deteriorate.sentenceEn: Our capacity to speak, write and learn new vocabulary does not seem to deteriorate with age.
deteriorate.translationZh: 我们的口语、写作和学习新词汇的能力似乎不会随着年龄增长而衰退。
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: Through no fault of their own, they can suddenly find their productivity deteriorating or quality control non-existent.
deteriorate.translationZh: 这并非他们自身的过错，却可能突然发现工作效率下降，或者质量控制荡然无存。
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: Last year, supporters pushed for Pedals to be moved to a shelter, but New Jersey officials have said they won't allow the bear to be captured and transferred to the facility "The bear would do better in its natural habitat and the agency would step in if its condition deteriorated ," they said.
deteriorate.translationZh: 去年，支持者们曾极力主张将"脚踏车"转移到庇护所，但新泽西州官员表示他们不会允许捕获这头熊并将其转移至该机构。"这头熊在自然栖息地会生活得更好，如果它的健康状况恶化，该机构将会介入。"他们说道。
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: The heritage situation in Venice has been deteriorating in the past few years.
deteriorate.translationZh: 过去几年，威尼斯的遗产状况一直在恶化。

deteriorate.sentenceEn: Los Angeles' homeless condition is deteriorating faster than many people predict.
deteriorate.translationZh: 洛杉矶的无家可归状况恶化速度超过了许多人的预测。

developed.sentenceEn: Traffic jams are a common problem of most big cities, either in developed or in developing countries, but one kind of traffic jams in particular can be especially frustrating.
developed.translationZh: 无论是发达国家还是发展中国家，交通拥堵都是大多数大城市的常见问题，但有一种交通拥堵尤其令人沮丧。

developed.sentenceEn: Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts.
developed.translationZh: 生活在大多数发达国家的我们许多人，正被食品公司和自封的健康专家制造的蛋白质缺乏神话所迷惑。
developed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

developed.sentenceEn: Research shows that in developed countries, more affluent and educated people tend to consume higher-quality diets—including more fruits and vegetables, fish and whole grains.
developed.translationZh: 研究表明，在发达国家，经济条件更优越且受教育程度更高的人群往往会消费更高质量的饮食——包括更多的水果、蔬菜、鱼类和全谷物。
developed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

developed.sentenceEn: Yet factory bosses in many developed countries are worried about a lack of skilled human workers—and see automation and robots as a solution.
developed.translationZh: 然而，许多发达国家的工厂老板却在为熟练工人短缺而担忧——并将自动化和机器人视为解决之道。
developed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

developed.sentenceEn: And when it comes to everyday technology skills, we are dead last when compared to other developed countries.
developed.translationZh: 而在日常科技技能方面，与其他发达国家相比，我们排在最后。
developed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

developed.sentenceEn: What can we learn from research on diets in developed countries?
developed.translationZh: 从发达国家的饮食研究中我们能了解到什么？

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: The people least interested in retraining are more likely to come from historically disadvantaged communities, more likely to have low incomes, and are more likely to have the least schooling after getting their high-school diploma or earlier.
disadvantaged.translationZh: 最缺乏再培训意愿的人群，往往更有可能来自历史上的弱势社区，更有可能收入偏低，且更有可能在高中毕业或更早之后就再未接受过教育。

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: They fear that students without internet access at home will be disadvantaged by the policy, and superintendent Tom Roth is concerned that e-learning days will offer a lower quality of education.
disadvantaged.translationZh: 他们担心家里没有互联网接入的学生将因这项政策而处于不利地位，而学监汤姆·罗斯则担忧在线学习日会提供质量较低的教育。

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: On the contrary, economically disadvantaged people report diets that are nutrient-poor and energy-dense.
disadvantaged.translationZh: 相反，经济条件较差的人群的饮食往往缺乏营养且热量密集。
disadvantaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: Instead, disadvantaged groups are constrained by their economic, material and social circumstances.
disadvantaged.translationZh: 相反，弱势群体受到其经济、物质和社会环境的制约。
disadvantaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: After all, not all socioeconomically disadvantaged people consume poor diets.
disadvantaged.translationZh: 毕竟，并非所有社会经济地位不利的人群都饮食不良。
disadvantaged.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

disadvantaged.sentenceEn: What does the author suggest disadvantaged people do to improve their health?
disadvantaged.translationZh: 作者建议弱势群体做些什么来改善他们的健康？

donkey.sentenceEn: But people still mostly fed carrots to horses, donkeys and pigs, and didn't eat them themselves.
donkey.translationZh: 但当时人们仍主要用胡萝卜喂马、驴和猪，自己并不食用。
donkey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

donkey.sentenceEn: Mules have strong muscles like horses, but they eat less, can work longer, and are gentler, like donkeys .
donkey.translationZh: 骡子像马一样拥有强壮的肌肉，但又像驴一样吃得更少、工作更久，性格也更温顺。
donkey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

donkey.sentenceEn: In 1785, King Charles III of Spain sent Washington a male donkey as a gift.
donkey.translationZh: 1785年，西班牙国王卡洛斯三世送给华盛顿一头公驴作为礼物。
donkey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

donkey.sentenceEn: It is the child of a donkey and a horse.
donkey.translationZh: 它是驴和马交配所生的后代。
donkey.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

donkey.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the donkey which is said to be the father of the U. S. mule industry?
donkey.translationZh: 关于那头被称为美国骡子产业之父的公驴，我们了解到什么？

donkey.sentenceEn: They can work longer than donkeys .
donkey.translationZh: 它们能比驴工作更长时间。
